calibration_traits.trait: Leaf area per leaf dry mass (specific leaf area, SLA)
Leaf dry mass per leaf fresh mass (Leaf dry matter content, LDMC)
Leaf nitrogen (N) content per leaf dry mass

interpretation: Non-flower-colour plant traits can satisfy a joint physical support requirement for both phylogenetic-time and within-species geographic analyses. Because source values were already opened on the superseded development branch, this result calibrates feasibility only and cannot count as prospective evidence for time-space coupling.
prohibited_uses: do not count as prospective replication
do not use the four listed traits as outcome-selected primary generalized traits
do not replace the frozen BIEN/AusTraits primary source order
do not infer any time-space coupling from source coverage
